stages.name: Radar and collection
stages.desc: Daily collection of signals from Roblox, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Google Trends and free search. Writes dated entity files and deltas to Drive.
stages.build_note: Running daily. 17 of 20 legs ok on 2026-10-18.

pendencies.text: First run with the new prompt on Oct 17. Weekly entity rebuild has never run.
Check the Apify Creative Center actor (period, country, cache): tiktok_trends came identical to the previous day.

flag.text: 3 stale legs on 2026-10-18: rblxdb_fastest_growing, rotrends, tiktok_trends (identical to the day before).

stages.name: Screening and advisor
stages.desc: Daily advisor that classifies themes as PASS, MAYBE or REJECT and logs each verdict to a ledger for backtesting.
stages.outputs: Daily verdicts, weekly thumbnails, Slack posts
stages.build_note: Running. 219 candidate rows on 2026-10-18: 39 PASS, 94 MAYBE, 86 REJECT. Ledger and backtest still empty.

pendencies.text: Advisor calibration review.
Ledger and backtest only carry signal after 28+ days.
Push notification only works in the app.
Review the 48 open postmortem amendments.

stages.name: Pre-validation
stages.desc: Quick scan of a chosen theme or idea: potential, one-line wedge and a yes, no or adjust call, before any brief is written.
stages.inputs: Themes from the advisor (Slack #roblox_trends_2 and the Reports tab) and your own ideas
stages.outputs: Class STRONG, PROMISING, WEAK or KILL, wedge, and a yes, no or adjust decision
stages.build_note: Each idea card runs a quick scan when it arrives and has its own chat. Not yet run on a real idea.

pendencies.text: Answer Yes, No or Adjust: K-pop tycoon, monster truck, Bid for Monsters.
Run the validator on a real idea.

stages.gate_note: You pick which ideas go on. Each card gets a quick scan; Yes starts the 2-page brief.

stages.name: 2-page brief
stages.desc: Only after a yes: a 2-page brief with the concept, the wedge and the hypothesis to test. It creates the proto_id.
stages.build_note: Part of the concept-validator skill. Not yet its own skill.

pendencies.text: Review the evidence tags in the commandments.
Decide the proto_id format.
Decide whether the brief becomes a skill separate from the pre-validation.

stages.no_task_note: No automated task of its own. The Phase 2 status lives on the pre-validation stage.

stages.name: Template match
stages.desc: Matches the brief to a template in the library and defines the variation slots and the uniqueness rule.

skills.name: one skill per template (e.g. steal an egg)

pendencies.text: Define how to pick the first template.
Define the variation slots per template.
Define the uniqueness rule between prototypes.

stages.no_task_note: No automated task: stage not built.

stages.name: Full doc
stages.desc: Merges the 2-page brief with the template documentation and describes the full test-game mechanics: loop, rules, tunables, analytics events, minimum scope.
stages.build_note: No skill written. Depends on the first template.

pendencies.text: Define the full doc format (fixed sections and per-template mechanics).
The doc can only be written after the first template is documented.

stages.no_task_note: No automated task: stage not built.
stages.gate_note: You approve the full doc before the build.

stages.name: Build
stages.desc: Builds the prototype with universal skills and the template's gameplay skill.
stages.build_note: Universal skills are partial. No template yet.

pendencies.text: Hello world in Studio.
Save the luau-standards and publish-pipeline cards.
Art and 3D map bottleneck.
Analytics can only be verified live.

stages.name: Title
stages.desc: Picks the game name and store listing title for each prototype. Has its own repository of principles, patterns and techniques that grows with what gets launched.
stages.outputs: Title options and the title used in the test
stages.build_note: Not built. Repository seeded from the commandments and the weekly advisor reports.

pendencies.text: Create the title skill. The repository tab holds the knowledge it will use.

stages.name: Thumbnail
stages.desc: Builds the storefront image for each prototype. Has its own repository of principles, patterns and techniques. The weekly advisor already produces genre-agnostic thumbnail hooks that feed it.
stages.inputs: Brief, prototype and the weekly thumbnail hooks
stages.outputs: Thumbnail options and the one used in the test
stages.build_note: Not built. Weekly hooks report exists in the advisor stage.

pendencies.text: Confirm whether Ads Manager reports per thumbnail.

stages.name: Publish and traffic
stages.desc: Publishing on Roblox and buying traffic for the test.

pendencies.text: Define budget, audience and duration per prototype.
Define who operates Ads Manager.
Target days from detection to live (hypothesis: 14).

stages.name: Metrics and learning
stages.desc: Reads metrics by proto_id, records wins and errors, feeds them back to the early stages and decides kill or scale.
stages.outputs: Retro, learning log, kill or scale decision
stages.build_note: The learning log exists. The metrics reader does not.

pendencies.text: Build the metrics reader after the first launch.
Per-template statistics only with 5+ prototypes.

stages.gate_note: Kill or scale is your call, based on the retro.

stages.name: Registry (proto_id)
stages.desc: Prototypes sheet with one row per proto_id: trend, brief, full doc, metrics and post mortem.
